# Fictional venous procedure policy V1

> FICTIONAL SOFTWARE TEST FIXTURE. This is not a real coverage policy, patient record, or medical recommendation.

<!-- page:1 -->
Policy identifier: FIX-VENOUS-001.
Revision date: 2026-10-01. Effective from: 2026-10-01.
Payer: Fixture Health Plan. Plan: Test Vascular.
This policy applies to endovenous ablation of a selected great saphenous vein.
Evidence must concern the selected anatomical target and be available on or before the assessment cutoff.
The following requirements all apply: demonstrated reflux, qualifying vein diameter, and one qualifying indication.
Demonstrated reflux: imaging documents reflux in the selected great saphenous vein.
Qualifying vein diameter: the selected vein diameter is at least 3.0 mm.
One qualifying indication means either an active ulcer at the selected target OR the persistent-symptom branch below.
Active ulcer: an active ulcer is documented on the selected leg.
The persistent-symptom branch requires all three: persistent pain, interference with routine daily tasks, and failed compression.
Persistent pain: pain in the selected leg persists at the time of the request.
Daily-task interference: the selected-leg symptoms interfere with routine daily tasks.
Failed compression: at least 90 consecutive days of compression have been completed and selected-leg pain persists.
Compression is not required by the active-ulcer alternative.
A summary assertion is evidence of what its author documented, not invented underlying measurements.
